description: This PHP source file is part of the TestLink open-source test management project. It generates a web page listing test cases from a specific test plan that have not been run and lack an assigned tester. The script includes initialization, data gathering, and table rendering logic related to test case management.

classes.name: tlExtTable
classes.description: A class representing an extendable, customizable table for displaying test case data with grouping, sorting, and custom rendering capabilities.

methods.name: buildTable
methods.description: Constructs a dynamic table object for displaying test case information with options to include platform and priority columns, and configures its grouping and sorting.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and returns parameters for the test case listing, based on session data and test plan manager info.

methods.name: featureLinks
methods.description: Generates HTML links with embedded JavaScript for test case execution history and editing features.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Sets up and returns a GUI object with page titles, labels, and options based on database info and request arguments.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Checks if the current user has the rights to view test plan metrics in the project.
